questions.q: From which week until birth does the fetal period extend?

options.e: Wrong. The 8th week is the end of the embryonic period.

options.e: Wrong. Organogenesis is the embryonic period (3rd-8th week).

options.t: Maturation of formed tissues and rapid growth
options.e: Correct. Organs are already formed; they mature and the fetus grows.

options.t: Length late, weight early in pregnancy
